Subject: Quick: need two matched references for GridWave (UK pilot)

Team —

We’re in late-stage discussions with GridWave (lead attached to DEAL-7841). They’ve asked for 1) a latency-critical energy-trading reference in EMEA and 2) an operational/observability reference that has handled short-lived model rollout incidents. They’re sensitive to market-impact numbers, so any advocate must be comfortable high-level only.

Requirements:
- Prefer UK or EU-based customers (pilot in London)
- Trading or market-making workloads (sub-200ms tail latency) for the first advocate
- Ops/monitoring + rollback story for the second
- Availability for a 30-minute call next week (Jul 20–23 window)

I’ve attached a short reference ask template to share with advocates once we have names. Priority: they’ll close in this quarter if we can line up two advocates by EOD Thu.

Proposed owners: Rishi — lead on trading advocate; Marissa — lead on ops advocate. Sergio — please take point on compliance gating (SOC2 + redaction notes).

Thanks —
Vanessa
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Vanessa —

Short list of realistic advocates who fit the ask and have agreed to speak about platform-level performance (high-level numbers only):

1) Northern Grid Partners — Tom Ellis (EMEA trading desk) 
   - Use case: automated intraday trading, integrated with exchange feeds
   - Comfort level: can do high-level latency and throughput descriptions; prefers non-disclosure of revenue impact
   - Contact: tom.ellis@northerngridpartners.eu

2) Aurora Energy Trading — Grace Hargreaves (UK)
   - Use case: algorithmic hedging and risk models; strong ops story with a recent canary rollback
   - Comfort level: OK to discuss rollout and monitoring but will redact P&L figures
   - Contact: grace.h@auroraenergy.co.uk

I can confirm availability next Tue/Wed mornings (UK window). I’ll call Tom and Grace now to confirm a tentative slot and give them the reference_ask_template + mutual_action_plan.xlsx. Sergio — flag anything else we should disclose before outreach.

—Rishi

Oliver —

Great speaking yesterday. We understand GridWave’s UK pilot needs a quick set of peer calls to validate performance and operational behavior before the procurement sign-off. Would you be open to a 30-minute reference call next week? We’ll limit discussion to platform architecture, deployment cadence, and high-level latency/availability outcomes — no detailed commercial figures unless you request it.

Suggested advocates (we’ve confirmed willingness to speak at a high level):
- Tom Ellis, Northern Grid Partners (EMEA trading desk) — trading latency story
- Grace Hargreaves, Aurora Energy Trading (UK) — ops/rollback + monitoring

Proposed times (UK window): Tue Jul 21 09:00–11:00 BST or Wed Jul 22 14:00–16:00 BST. If none of those work, send two slots that work for your team and we’ll match.

I’ve attached a short mutual action plan and a one-pager agenda. If GridWave legal wants a short NDA or restrictions on the call, we can redact anything commercial in advance — Sergio (cc’d) can advise.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
